question: Which of the following Indian sports shooters won the gold medal in the 10-metre air pistol event in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saurabh Chaudhary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saurabh Chaudhary is an Indian sport shooter:**

 
 
• He was born on **12 May 2002,** in **Meerut, Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• He won the **gold medal** in the **ISSF World Cup in the 10-metre air pistol** event in 2019.
 
• He was the youngest Indian to win **Gold in Asian Games** in 2018.
 
• As of 2022, he also **won gold in the men’s 10m Air Pistol** event at the **International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) World Cup in Cairo, Egypt**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ISSF World Cup was started in **1986 by International Shooting Sport Federation**.
 
• In 2019 it was held in** China**.
 
• **India tops the chart** by winning five gold, two silver and a bronze in 2019.
 
• In the 2022 World Cup, **India again finishes on top of the table with 15 medals**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__ **
